HOURS.title: What the pay has to cover: Quito and Denver
HOURS.question: A family in north Quito and a family in Denver need food, rent and bus fare. How much of what they earn does that take, at the minimum wage and at what Center families actually earn?
HOURS.notice: The Center's families qualify because they earn less than the minimum wage. Divide their income by five people and compare it with Ecuador's own poverty line. Then look at Denver: one full-time minimum-wage job barely covers the same three needs for five people there too. The difference is what catches a Denver family when the pay runs short (try One bad week), and how many Denver workers are paid at least the minimum. In Quito, most Center families are not.
HOURS.yourCall: Which of the three costs would the Quito family cut first, and what would that cost them later?
